review.note: 2026-11-05 h2h-dev-tools 0.11.1 compatible patch dependency review. Only the private offline-wheel site-directory subprocess protocol changes to standard-library JSON; the existing escaped .pth serialization, public CLI, dependencies, Python >=3.14 requirement and all bounds remain unchanged. Reviewed current upstream release notes: hatchling 1.33.0 adds Python3.15 support (https://hatch.pypa.io/dev/history/hatchling/); distlib 0.4.4 includes launcher-error and archive-containment fixes (https://distlib.readthedocs.io/en/latest/overview.html#change-log-for-distlib); packaging 26.3 adds range APIs and marker/specifier corrections while requiring Python >=3.9 (https://packaging.pypa.io/en/stable/changelog.html); build 1.6.1 fixes the Windows symlink regression (https://build.pypa.io/en/stable/changelog.html). Mypy 2.4.1 fixes overload checking and mypyc frame-private functions (https://mypy.readthedocs.io/en/stable/changelog.html); pytest 9.2.0 changes plugin-error reporting and hash-based assertion caches (https://docs.pytest.org/en/stable/changelog.html), whose existing source-authority regression suite remains required; pytest-xdist 3.8.0 adds loadscope ordering controls (https://pytest-xdist.readthedocs.io/en/latest/changelog.html). Ruff 0.17.3 corrects f-string conversions (https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff/releases/tag/0.17.3); markdownlint-cli2 0.24.0 updates dependencies and retains the prior Node >=22 requirement (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DavidAnson/markdownlint-cli2/v0.24.0/CHANGELOG.md). These stable versions match the preceding 0.11.0 audit and are admitted by the existing declarations; no out-of-bound stable version is identified. The generator independently records current registry versions and non-yanked Python3.14-compatible artifacts. The clean local environment was rebuilt through the normal resolver. The complete offline-wheel test file passed14 tests, including real CR/CRLF imports, LF/space controls and a literal-whitespace protocol test; the old implementation failed the three intended negative controls. No native Windows execution is claimed. Final exact-candidate review, full release gate and artifact validation remain required; this audit is not a publishing receipt.
